Chief_Complaint.content: Left arm numbness, tingling, and weakness for approximately 2 weeks, worsening
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: L arm numbness/tingling and weakness x ~2 wks; worsening

History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Tingling/numbness from elbow into forearm/hand; palmar digits 2–4

Occasional left shoulder pain associated with boxing movements
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Occasional shoulder pain with boxing movements

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Left arm symptoms have been present for approximately 2 weeks and are progressive

Right hand knuckle pain associated with boxing

Mother has type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia

Assessment.content: Left upper extremity paresthesia and weakness for approximately 2 weeks, involving palmar digits 2–4, progressive, and not limited by pain

Assessment.content: Transient left eye visual field loss lasting about 20 minutes, now resolved
Assessment.source_text: 2) Transient L eye visual field loss (~20 min), resolved

Assessment.content: Concern for demyelinating process such as multiple sclerosis given neurologic symptoms; requires urgent workup

Assessment.content: Right hand knuckle pain likely related to boxing and mild in severity
Assessment.source_text: 4) R hand knuckle pain likely boxing-related, mild

Plan_of_Care.content: No steroids or treatment until diagnosis is confirmed
Emergency department or A&E precautions if weakness spreads to legs, new or worsening headache, vomiting, fits, or worsening visual symptoms
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • ED/A&E precautions: if weakness spreads to legs, new/worsening HA, vomiting, fits, or worsening visual sx

Plan_of_Care.content: Continue current symptomatic measures as needed and avoid new medications until evaluated by neurology
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Continue current symptomatic measures as needed; avoid new meds until evaluated by neurology

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient instructed to seek emergency care if leg weakness develops, headaches worsen, vomiting occurs, seizures occur, or visual symptoms worsen
Follow_up_Information.source_text: • ED/A&E precautions: if weakness spreads to legs, new/worsening HA, vomiting, fits, or worsening visual sx
